entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Philipp Jakob Straub was an Austrian sculptor. He was from a well-known family of German Baroque sculptors. His father Johann George Straub and his brothers Johann Baptist, Joseph, and Johann Georg Straub were also sculptors, as was his nephew Franz Xaver Messerschmidt.
